summary: Quiet residential kerb with houses 12-14 m away on the same side.
reasons: No cars parked on this west kerb
Gentle slope, no gates or signs

best_section.where: West kerb of Taringa Parade, between the side street and the bend north

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb on the west side, nearest mapped dwellings 12-14 m from the section; wide front verges and trees give some screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a kerbside lane; room to pull in at the kerb, no gate or barrier.
drivers.traffic: Through residential street with moderate traffic; cars drive past but the van stands in the kerb lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the east kerb in imagery but none on this west side, so a van would stand out a little.

flags: Dwellings 10-14 m away along the whole stretch
No parked cars on this side
sun_shade: Mostly open; some street-tree shade from the west side, morning sun from the east over the road.
